label: Bible Study
prompt: With all lowliness and meekness, with _____, forbearing one another in love;
verse: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
note: Four virtues for keeping church family together — longsuffering is patience that goes the distance.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never _____, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verse: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
note: Eternal life, never perishing, and no one able to pluck them out — Jesus holds His sheep tight.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and _____ bones received strength.
verse: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
note: The KJV spells it 'ancle' — and the lame man's feet and ancle bones got strong enough to leap.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were _____ until the going down of the sun.
verse: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
note: Israel won against Amalek only while Moses' arms stayed up — so Aaron and Hur held them, one on each side.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He, that being often reproved _____ his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verse: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
note: Reproved often but still 'hardeneth his neck' — he 'shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.' Warnings run out.
